headSubject: fix(kernel): widen RUN-31 degraded-concurrency test timeouts, close RUN-31
summary: Implemented roadmap Session 1 (NPDEV_MEGA_ROADMAP.md): measured first and found the depth-2 aggregate workbench primitive already built and in production (WmsOffice Movimento), so the session became building the two genuinely-missing pieces on top of it -- a grouped, role-partitioned aggregate.balances[] DSL surface (schema x4 + AST + compiled + parser + compiler + canonical JSON round-trip + AggregateValidation, plus a new BalanceEvaluator runtime shared by AggregateRuntime's commit-time hard gate and a new on-demand, non-persisting checkBalances REST endpoint/workbenchAction), and aggregateCollection.lookupFields[] (query-sourced, read-only per-row bounds attached at load time, enforced for free by the existing invariants[] engine). Wired end-to-end through AutoPanelExpander and workbench-page.html.mustache (read-only lookup columns, a Recalcular-Saldos banner). Added a combined depth-2+balance+lookup+lifecycle fixture (StockTransferAggregate) to NPDevSamples/dsl-conformance-max, registered 4 new check-dsl-coverage.py detectors (closing aggregate.invariants' pre-existing zero-coverage gap too), and added targeted unit tests (BalanceEvaluator, AggregateRuntime, AggregateValidation).
nextStep: Session 1's remaining item: drive the generated dsl-conformance-max app (StockTransferWorkbench) through a real browser via verify-in-browser/ScrapForAI to confirm the balance banner, read-only lookup column and post-commit lifecycle lock actually render/interact correctly -- blocked this session only by sample-app API-key bootstrap friction (npdev.auth.api-keys not resolving via env var or a fresh application-npdev-auth.properties for this freshly-generated sample; root cause not yet found), not by anything in the feature code itself. After that, Session 1 is fully done and NEXT should move to Session 2 (close the AI authoring loop) or Sessions 3/4/5 per the roadmap's dependency graph.
verified: Full :NPDevContract:dsl:test (992 tests) green; NPDevRuntimeHost/runtimehost-core full test suite green including new BalanceEvaluatorTest/AggregateRuntimeBalanceTest; full scripts/quality/run-generator-gate.ps1 passed (deterministic generation, generator governance, DSL reference + floor, T2 release-gate validation against the updated dsl-conformance-max fixture, out-of-tree generation, trusted-source security, coverage ratchet all green, dsl coverage floor auto-ratcheted 85.1628%->85.3056%); check-dsl-coverage.py OK with all 4 new features covered; check-twin-pair-consistency.py and check-schema-mirror-consistency.py both OK with no new entries needed; dsl-conformance-max model.json validates with 0 errors/warnings at T2; the generated StockTransferWorkbenchWorkbench.html was confirmed to contain the new checkBalances/readOnlyColumns wiring. NOT verified: live browser interaction (app boot blocked on local API-key config, not a code issue).
